name: Why does my bathtub drain make a gurgling sound?

mainEntity.name: Why does my bathtub drain make a gurgling sound?

acceptedAnswer.text: A gurgling sound from your bathtub drain often indicates a partial clog or an issue with your plumbing vent system. When water drains, it creates a vacuum that pulls air through the easiest path. If the drain is partially blocked, air might be pulled through the P-trap, causing the gurgling sound. A blocked or improperly installed vent pipe can also cause gurgling by preventing proper airflow in the plumbing system, leading to slow drainage and noise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gurgling often signals a partial clog in the drain or an issue with the plumbing vent system.
